metadata.description: docs/issue/ tracker that agents edit directly, kept in shape by a Claude Mods hooks module

plugins.name: local-issue
plugins.description: docs/issue/ の issue を agent が直接編集し、mod が tool の実行後ごとに frontmatter を揃え、INDEX.md を生成し、close した issue を archive/ へ移す。Agents edit docs/issue/ files directly; a hooks module normalizes the frontmatter, regenerates INDEX.md and archives closed issues after every tool call.
